reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 curation
reserveReview.rationale: The direct Sky MakerCore feed reports the complete seven-group debt envelope used by the live reserve adapter. Official protocol documentation establishes the PSM, Agent, crypto-vault, and Staking Engine failure domains; aggregate groups are classified conservatively without inventing look-through asset weights or liquidity terms.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Relative debt reported by the Sky MakerCore group endpoint and mapped through the canonical sky-makercore adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The PSM group combines external stablecoins without publishing constituent weights in the group feed. The remaining groups are classified at their protocol or obligor failure domain and are not represented as direct tracked-stablecoin dependencies.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The published group combines several PSM assets without per-asset weights.
Grove is a Sky Agent allocation into institutional-credit strategies, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Spark is an allocator and lending-protocol position with multiple deployment counterparties, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Obex is an Agent allocation across supported institutional stablecoin projects rather than one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Core bucket is a multi-collateral crypto-vault pool, not one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Staking Engine bucket is collateralized by SKY positions in LockStake Engine vaults, not by another tracked stablecoin.
The legacy RWA bucket represents external legal structures and obligors rather than a direct tracked-stablecoin dependency.
